title: Contractor Profit vs Plywood

scenes.video_prompt: Handheld vertical phone camera shot on an Indian construction site in natural daylight. A tired Indian contractor in a safety vest stands looking down at a stack of broken, swollen, splintered brown wooden shuttering plywood. He gestures in disappointment at the damaged wood. Rough concrete slab in background, no text or logos anywhere.
